content.what_it_is: Small fixed-form Fortran utility (unnamed main program) in the spherical conical-island benchmark input directory. Reads a 702x602 depth grid from depth.txt row-by-row with list-directed input (L3-7), multiplies every value by 100.0 (L9-13, 'blow up' the depth, e.g. m to cm), and writes the scaled grid to depth_blowup.txt with format 1000f12.3 (L15-19). Closes files and ends (L21-22).
entities: unnamed main program (no PROGRAM statement; end @L22); parameter(m=702,n=602) @L1; real depth(m,n) @L2; statement label 100 format(1000f12.3) @L19; implicit loop indices i,j
unresolved: Whether *100.0 converts m to cm or is an amplification experiment ('blowup') is not stated; the FORMAT allows up to 1000 values per record while m=702 -- fine, but the fixed 702x602 dimensions must match the actual depth.txt, unverifiable here.
Implicit typing: i,j integers and everything else default -- no IMPLICIT NONE; program has no name.
